mapper.select: select * from ai_file_upload where state in ('initializing', 'uploading') and expires_at <= current_timestamp order by expires_at, id limit 20 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update ai_file_upload set state = 'cancelled', update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and state in ('initializing', 'uploading') and expires_at <= current_timestamp
